Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.api.v3

Class CurrencySettings

java.lang.Object
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.api.v3.CurrencySettings
public class CurrencySettings extends Object
Part of member info payload, currencySettings is a sibling to name and other base level properties. 
 "currencySettings": {
   "precision": -1,
   "scale": 0,
   "symbol": "$",
   "reportingCurrency": true,
   "thousandsSeparator": "NONE",
   "decimalSeparator": "DOT",
   "negativeSign": "PREFIXED_MINUS",
   "negativeColor": "BLACK"
 },
